subpageUsage:
Same Faq component as the homepage, configured by props (no explicit `variant` prop). Subpages pass a one-line heading string (no
split; /content/custom-content wraps it in a 34rem span for width only) and their own 3-15 items; answers are plain text everywhere except /pricing, where they carry a bold 'Yes.' lead and/or one inline link. Layout is identical to the homepage: centred H2 (max 60rem) 4.375rem above a 42rem column of independent accordion cards (surface-1, radius, question + rotating cross icon). Used on /lms, /lms/small-business, /lms/corporate-lms, /lms/enterprise, /lms/solutions, /lms/spring-release, /lms/demo-platform, /pricing, /lms/features, /nova, /lms/mentoring-software, the 15 non-empty /lms/features/* routes, /content/custom-content, /mentoring, /case-studies/lms, /company, /company/why-nimbus, /whats-included and /contact-us.
evidenceNotes: Counts and lengths were measured by server-rendering every registered route with Faq stubbed to record its props (not by reading literals), so filler-generated answers (faqItems() in src/pages/platform/faq.js and src/pages/company/shared.js) are included. Longest question: 22 words (/lms/spring-release); longest answer: 65 words (/company/why-nimbus); longest heading 7 words (/nova).

The homepage contract's adjacency rule (FAQ immediately precedes conversion.demo-form) does not hold on subpages: on the 15 feature routes the KikiTabs explore block follows the FAQ, and on every other subpage the next block is the Footer's subpage CTA (conversion.demo-cta), except /company where the home-style demo form follows.
/lms/features/employee-experience and /lms/features/communication render a page-local FaqEmpty ('No FAQs found.') instead of Faq.

pages-manifest.json's page-nova template has no faq section although Nova.jsx renders Faq ('Questions about your new AI learning assistant'); /lms/professional-services has no Faq in code or manifest.
